# compare fixture

`logic.json` is the stage-2 fixture at `../stage2/logic.json` folded with `../stage2/exports/signed.json` (`render_spec.py fold` run on a copy in a directory named `stage2`), copied here unchanged. `comparison.json`, `expected-hashes.json`, `exports/` and `invalid/` are hand-built for stage 3 and tie to that signed spec. All content is synthetic: no real company, product, customer or person appears in any file.
